positive_sequences.name: four_additions_one_subject
positive_sequences.scenario: One subject adds four members to privileged groups.
positive_sequences.rationale: The event count reaches the threshold inside the window.

positive_sequences.name: five_additions_mixed_groups
positive_sequences.scenario: One subject adds five members across two privileged groups.
positive_sequences.rationale: The event count exceeds the threshold inside the window.

negative_sequences.name: two_additions_below_threshold
negative_sequences.scenario: One subject adds two members to a privileged group.
negative_sequences.rationale: The event count remains below the threshold.

negative_sequences.name: additions_spread_across_subjects
negative_sequences.scenario: Four additions performed by four different subjects.
negative_sequences.rationale: No single subject group reaches the threshold.

negative_sequences.name: additions_to_non_privileged_group
negative_sequences.scenario: Five additions to an ordinary application group.
negative_sequences.rationale: The base rule does not select these events, so no group key accumulates.

notes: All sequences are synthetic and deterministic. Negative sequences break exactly one correlation requirement each: ordering, grouping, threshold, or timespan.
